parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotency of the request and prevent repeated submissions. The token is generated by the client and must be unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: The number of user API keys.

parameters.name: CreditToken
parameters.description: The redemption code. If specified, the recharge-type activation branch is used, and the count and quota are populated from the database.
